protocol.candidateOrder: AB/BA alternates with outer round and configuration
protocol.workerOrder: rotated/reversed between processes and within each executable
protocol.firstBuild: Serial reference runs first in every process; retained separately
protocol.timing: Full buildStreamMeshletsForPrimitive; input copy, hashing, runtime initialization and source generation excluded
protocol.cache: Each process starts a new runtime and adapter; allocator and OS caches warm during serial references/warmup
protocol.correctness: Full logical geometry/LOD hash must agree across every worker count, candidate, phase and repetition
protocol.scope: Generated meshlet/LOD workload, not production scene rendering or FPS
protocol.quantiles: Nearest rank; small sample P95/P99 commonly equal maximum, not a rare-tail estimate
protocol.externalLoad: Not controlled by this script; record other activity separately
